cards.finding: Full-update acquisition was 228–235/384 across three draws; preservation and abstention varied more.
cards.next_discriminating_test: The locked Sparse A/B study on fresh reviewed six-domain cohorts, with the user strict gates.
cards.not_proved: Balanced assistant improvement or universally stable learning/retention.
cards.quality_rule: Select on paired domain outcomes and source-correct losses, not acquisition alone.

cards.counterevidence: One long-context null and arithmetic regressions; no acquisition-matched scalar in REP-001; preservation suites spent/report-only.
cards.lane_separation: Existing PRSC is Supa 1.7/220 historical tensors; it cannot silently authorize Sparse/q-v LoRA.
cards.next_discriminating_test: Compare new full update, fixed magnitude mask, acquisition-matched scalar and per-tensor energy control. Transform only the new update above Sparse.

cards.counterevidence: Higher precision is not a universal quality advantage. Sparse FP32 is the specified artifact, not a quality guarantee.
cards.finding: Dense BF16 export erased 60.61% of update coordinates and 24/220 trained tensors; long context changed 157→162 but retained answers 40→39.
cards.quality_rule: Freeze actual stored/evaluated bytes, precision and runtime. An upcast does not recover an erased update.

cards.finding: The latest physical record reports consecutive Torch 2.6 builds e2c311e5… and a28629c9… with identical retained norm; copied prereg lacks this correction.
cards.not_proved: Root cause, actual tensor/support differences, historical commit authenticity, or that every rebuild discrepancy is harmless.
cards.preservation: Both report copies and the canonical artifact pin are preserved; no historical metadata overwritten.
cards.quality_rule: Separate full-file identity, ordered tensor-content identity and mask-support identity. Matching aggregate counts/norms cannot substitute.

cards.finding: Attenuation explained 235→223 of a 235→219 composition change. Same-global-norm block profiles had acquisition 184–243; matched-magnitude same-skill control did not produce the boundary donor benefit.
cards.quality_rule: Use component-only controls at the exact same coefficient; distinguish magnitude, support, direction and serialization.

cards.finding: FA clipped interaction passed its margin while strict canary fell 102→6. CONFIRM-002 TH25 gained boundary behavior but answerable correctness fell 37→35 despite unchanged 109 attempts.
cards.not_proved: That preserved likelihood, attempts, formatting-tolerant counts or one skill implies balanced assistant gain.
cards.quality_rule: Keep content, output validity, appropriate abstention, answer attempts and correctness separate. The user strict quality gate rejects a net-regression domain.

cards.finding: Low-margin loss prediction had AUC .77 on exposed rows, but tolerant teacher-forced margin agreement was only 168/192. Boosting the donor had a confidence interval crossing zero.
cards.next_discriminating_test: Require actual full-vocabulary vectors at identical visited prefixes; certify decision preservation and stop at first divergence. Never infer unseen continuations or use gold-prefix proxy agreement as exact greedy evidence.
